sc-n-seasons.label: SRH seasons in the warehouse
sc-n-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sc-n-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (1) OR m.team2_id IN (1)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

sc-titles.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM matches m WHERE m.date = (SELECT MAX(x.date) FROM matches x WHERE x.season_id = m.season_id) AND (m.team1_id IN (1) OR m.team2_id IN (1))

sc-runner.label: Sunrisers Hyderabad's leading run-scorer in 2021
sc-runner.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sc-runner.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (1) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2021 GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1

sc-runs.label: Runs by that player in 2021
sc-runs.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sc-runs.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (1) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2021 GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1

sc-bowler.label: Sunrisers Hyderabad's leading wicket-taker in 2021
sc-bowler.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sc-bowler.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (1) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2021 AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY wk DESC LIMIT 1

sc-wk.label: Wickets by that player in 2021
sc-wk.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sc-wk.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (1) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2021 AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY wk DESC LIMIT 1
